end.summary:
Riya practised locating fractions on a number line, including 5/4 and 2/5.
They discussed dividing the interval from 0 to 1 into equal parts.
Riya mixed up the first mark after 0 with 1 and did not complete the teach-back.
They briefly identified triangle sides and vertices during a game.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing fractions on a number line and used the ideas of equal parts and marks between 0 and 1. Riya connected triangles with three sides and identified two triangles in the game. They mixed up the first mark after 0 with 1, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, draw 0 and 1, divide the space into 5 equal parts, and label each mark 1/5, 2/5, 3/5, and 4/5 from left to right.
